title: TypeError when saving settings with an empty email
body:
Steps to reproduce:
1. Open Settings
2. Leave the email field blank
3. Click Save

Expected: a validation error asking for an email.
Actual: the app crashes.

```
TypeError: argument of type 'NoneType' is not iterable
  File settings/views.py, line 214, in save_settings
```

Version: 2.4.1, Ubuntu 24.04, Python 3.12. Happens every time.
